verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an API platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an MCP server or hosted MCP endpoint. Tool calling, llms.txt, markdown docs and OpenAPI specs are related developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
